messages:
Maya Chen: Quick question — we need to carve out 3x 45m micro enablement sessions for Trailhead customers next week. Prefer mornings for APAC, afternoons for NA. Can people volunteer to own slots?

Jonah Patel: I can take Mon 09:30 PDT (APAC-friendly overlap). happy to run a hands-on walk through quickstart. :+1:

Priya Singh: I can cover Wed 14:00 PDT (NA) — will prep a short checklist and demo. @Maya can you share the feature priorities?

Maya Chen: Priority: 1) onboarding health checks 2) model pinning & rollouts 3) cost/perf tips for Dedicated. Keep to 45m, 10 min Q&A.

Liam O'Connor: I can do Fri 08:00 GMT (EMEA morning) but that's tight for APAC. If we need APAC late-evening I'll swap.

Carlos Reyes: Heads up — two Trailhead accounts have renewal flags. Would prefer we layer in a 5-min renewal health reminder in each session.

Priya Singh: Good call @Carlos. I'll add a 5-min slide at the end: renewal checklist + CS contact.

Amelia (calendar-bot): Poll created: https://cal.example/s/Trailhead-micro-sessions — vote for preferred slots. Options: Mon 16:30 UTC, Wed 21:00 UTC, Fri 07:00 UTC.

Jonah Patel: Voted. Also proposing a lightweight agenda snippet so presenters can reuse: ```Agenda:
- 0-5m: quick intros + renewal note
- 5-25m: demo: onboarding & model pinning
- 25-40m: cost/perf tips + config checklist
- 40-45m: Q&A and next steps```

Maya Chen: This is great. Can each presenter drop a one-line prep doc in the shared folder by EOD Thursday? Link: https://drive.example/enablement/trailhead-microprep

Liam O'Connor: Dropping mine there now. I can also record and share a 6-min clip for customers who miss the live slot.

Carlos Reyes: I'll follow up with the two at-risk accounts after the sessions and capture any churn signals.

Priya Singh: Small logistics note — request AV check 10m before start and enable recording. @Amelia can you auto-add a pre-meeting reminder?

Amelia (calendar-bot): Reminder set: 10 minutes prior for all sessions. Recording enabled by default.

Maya Chen: Perfect. Last ask — capture feedback via the 2-question pulse at the end: 1) Was this useful? 2) Biggest blocker now? I'll paste the survey text here later.

Jonah Patel: Simple NPS-style + blocker question works. I'll stitch the survey into the calendar description.

Priya Singh: All good from me. Thanks everyone :rocket:

Liam O'Connor: Thanks — see you on the poll results.

Maya Chen: Closing the loop — schedule locked once poll hits 3 volunteers. Will post final slots here.
